verdict.rationale: Logseq documents both a URI scheme (logseq://x-callback-url/quickCapture) that can be triggered from browser bookmarks or command line to capture/open notes, and a local HTTP APIs server enabling authorized external programmatic access to the graph — directly matching the story's ask for deep links and a local endpoint for scripting. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the HTTP API's request/response schema or third-party integration examples, and no evidence of a broader public REST API spec (openapi probes returned 404).
